title: Multiscale Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for UAV Anomaly Detection

paper_equation_aligned_completion.input_embedding: temporal Conv1D projection with positional embedding
paper_equation_aligned_completion.router: top-3 Fourier seasonal reconstruction plus adaptive multi-kernel trend routing
paper_equation_aligned_completion.sparse_mixture: four experts per block with top-3 routing and balance loss
paper_equation_aligned_completion.expert: patch-level intrapatch attention and causal KNN graph propagation
paper_equation_aligned_completion.reconstruction: three residual GMoE blocks followed by pointwise reconstruction
paper_equation_aligned_completion.selection_constraint: training and early stopping use normal train/validation flights only

protocol_adaptations: Keep the official repository read-only and pinned for provenance only.
Complete unavailable core operations from the published equations in an auditable clean-room implementation.
Use the fixed ALFA 29/1/16 common-data split and train-normal-only Z-score statistics.
Do not access the failure/test split during training epochs.
Replace native labels, ATSSD and point adjustment with causal EMA plus flightwise SPOT.
Report Micro label_any metrics under the shared revision protocol.
